source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 21. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.

learn.en: Before the revelation, the Prophet ﷺ saw true dreams — each came true like the bright morning. (Bukhari 3)
learn.title: True dreams

learn.en: Then he loved to be alone. He went to the Cave of Ḥirāʾ and worshipped Allah there for many nights. (Bukhari 3)
learn.title: The Cave of Ḥirāʾ

learn.en: Ḥirāʾ is a small cave near the top of Jabal an-Nūr, the Mountain of Light, a few kilometres from the Kaʿbah.
learn.title: The Mountain of Light

learn.en: There he thought about Allah's creation and stayed far from idol worship. He never bowed to an idol.
learn.title: Thinking and worshipping

learn.en: Khadījah prepared food for him to take — family support matters!
learn.title: Family support

quiz.en: Where did the Prophet ﷺ go to worship alone?

opts: Jabal an-Nūr, the Mountain of Light

quiz.en: True or false? The Prophet ﷺ never bowed to an idol.
True or false? Khadījah prepared his food.

think.q: Could you have 10 minutes of quiet time with Allah this week — no screens, just du'aa and a few verses?
think.a: Yes! Find a quiet corner, make du'aa, and think about one thing Allah created.

parents.summary: Before revelation, the Prophet ﷺ saw true dreams and loved to worship alone in the Cave of Ḥirāʾ on the Mountain of Light, with Khadījah's support.
parents.tip: Make a family “quiet corner” for du'aa and reflection.
